reason: Internal only and inert unless [culture] enabled is turned on, in which case it DOES change what Nora says: the room's culture account now reaches the prompt as a <culture> block on the tag path and the participation turn. It is the only block in that prompt about the room itself rather than about a moment in it — its neighbours answer what was said, what is unsettled, where she had got to; this one answers what this place is and why it is like that. The block asserts its own age, because nothing in the tier retires and a head may legitimately be weeks old and still be right. It is escaped and marked untrusted for the same reason the standing block is: the body is model-authored prose folded from the room's own messages, so a forged closing tag is reachable from what the room wrote. The relevance gate deliberately does NOT read it - prior measurement found that gate getting worse with more context. The proactive adaptor does not either, because it is keyed on a workspace while culture is keyed on a room. The note-candidates pass does not, because its own design states that what a room IS must be the operator's sentence and not a model's, which contradicts this tier's premise and is a disagreement for the operator to settle rather than for a wiring change to paper over. Nothing a member of a room can observe until the tier is enabled.
